Cautiously supportive policy stance with clear downside risks. The FOMC remains highly accommodative (near-zero rates, ongoing Treasury/MBS purchases, repo/RRP, reinvestments), and SLOOS points to firm demand for safer, GSE/QM mortgage categories even as standards stay tight and business loan demand softens. However, Beige Book reports ongoing COVID-19-related disruptions among shippers and producers, signaling persistent supply-chain/logistics constraints that weigh on activity and add uncertainty. Balancing policy support and resilient core mortgage demand against these real-economy frictions, the overall tone is somewhat more negative than a risk-only read but weaker than the prior assessment.
